name: Atlassian Design System
summary: A collaboration-oriented product system built from explicit foundations, an 8-pixel spacing base, semantic tokens, and reusable interaction patterns that must work across a large family of products.
best_for: systems that need a stable shared grammar across many teams
avoid_for: single-purpose brand sites where product-family consistency is not a constraint
designs that need irregular handcrafted spacing as a core expressive device
